title: The Endless Smile
author: Edmund Reyes
blurb: Xanthe Lockridge, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
